segments: "THE ROCK " in bold white text fades in on a black screen, then quickly fades out
Underwater scene on the sea floor with lots of prehistoric sea creatures. A nautilus swims across the frame
Now above water, we see a large mountain with eyes and a round nose. A couple dragonflies fly across the frame
Wide shot of the mountain, who blinks his eyes sleepily and then falls asleep
The sky grows dark, clouds start to form, and snow covers the mountain and the surrounding ground. A herd of mammoths emerge in the upper left corner
Close view of the boulder's face. The sound of a tree being chopped down wakes him up
The boulder uses his arms to lift himself out of the ground and starts to walk
While the boulder is sleeping, a rope is slung over his nose. The rope pulls is pulled, waking the boulder up
Suddenly the door opens and some soldiers wearing blue uniforms and holding bayonets walk in
Suddenly cut to a factory. A large machine crushes the wheel into smaller pieces
A soldier blows a whistle and rings a bell, and three cannons fire
A piece of the cannonball falls into the water and starts sinking.
The rock, now very small, washes up on a bed of other rocks
The rock is walking along a path. In the background, a farmer uses a tractor on top of a large boulder, and a plane flies overhead
A hand suddenly picks up the rock, who is startled awake
Black screen suddenly flashes white - a picture is being taken. Behind the camera, a crowd is gathered
A kid suddenly presses his face up against the glass, shaking the exhibit and knocking the fossil off of its stand
The man throws out the trash into the street and the fossil falls, breaking into smaller pieces. Upbeat jazz music starts playing
The man throws the fossil at a window
The fossil rolls out through an open window
A road roller suddenly rolls up from behind the fossil and pulverizes it into a tiny speck of dust
A man with a broom is sweeping the floor, and sweeps up the pile of sand down the street and onto a beach
Suddenly an excavator grabs the pile of sand containing the grain of sand
The sand is transported to a giant crucible of molten glass
A mold comes off and the grain of sand now is a plate of glass
A wide shot of a rocket flying lifting off from earth
The spacecraft engine ignites and it starts shooting through space
The stars in the sky start to spin, as if to indicate the passage of time. Slowly, the landscape shifts and mountains form
